help.short: The name of the agent pool.
The name of the managed cluster resource.

description: Get a specific machine in the specified agent pool.

operations.description: Get a specific machine in the specified agent pool.

params.description: The name of the agent pool.
params.name: agentPoolName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The name of the managed cluster resource.
params.name: resourceName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Resource ID.
props.name: id

props.description: The name of the resource that is unique within a resource group. This name can be used to access the resource.
props.name: name

props.description: The properties of the machine
props.name: properties

props.description: Unique read-only string used to implement optimistic concurrency. The eTag value will change when the resource is updated. Specify an if-match or if-none-match header with the eTag value for a subsequent request to enable optimistic concurrency per the normal eTag convention.
props.name: eTag

props.description: The hardware and GPU settings of the machine.
props.name: hardware

props.description: GPUInstanceProfile to be used to specify GPU MIG instance profile for supported GPU VM SKU.
props.name: gpuInstanceProfile

props.description: The GPU settings of the machine.
props.name: gpuProfile

props.description: Whether to install GPU drivers. When it's not specified, default is Install.
props.name: driver

props.description: Specify the type of GPU driver to install when creating Windows agent pools. If not provided, AKS selects the driver based on system compatibility. This cannot be changed once the AgentPool has been created. This cannot be set on Linux AgentPools. For Linux AgentPools, the driver is selected based on system compatibility.
props.name: driverType

props.description: The size of the VM. VM size availability varies by region. If a node contains insufficient compute resources (memory, cpu, etc) pods might fail to run correctly. For more details on restricted VM sizes, see: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/aks/quotas-skus-regions
props.name: vmSize

props.description: The Kubernetes configurations used by the machine.
props.name: kubernetes

props.description: Configuration for using artifact streaming on AKS.
props.name: artifactStreamingProfile

props.description: Artifact streaming speeds up the cold-start of containers on a node through on-demand image loading. To use this feature, container images must also enable artifact streaming on ACR. If not specified, the default is false.
props.name: enabled

props.description: The version of Kubernetes running on the machine. If orchestratorVersion was a fully specified version <major.minor.patch>, this field will be exactly equal to it. If orchestratorVersion was <major.minor>, this field will contain the full <major.minor.patch> version being used.
props.name: currentOrchestratorVersion

props.description: The Kubelet configuration on the machine.
props.name: kubeletConfig

props.description: Allowed list of unsafe sysctls or unsafe sysctl patterns (ending in `*`).
props.name: allowedUnsafeSysctls

props.description: The maximum number of container log files that can be present for a container. The number must be ≥ 2.
props.name: containerLogMaxFiles

props.description: The maximum size (e.g. 10Mi) of container log file before it is rotated.
props.name: containerLogMaxSizeMB

props.description: If CPU CFS quota enforcement is enabled for containers that specify CPU limits. The default is true.
props.name: cpuCfsQuota

props.description: The CPU CFS quota period value. The default is '100ms.' Valid values are a sequence of decimal numbers with an optional fraction and a unit suffix. For example: '300ms', '2h45m'. Supported units are 'ns', 'us', 'ms', 's', 'm', and 'h'.
props.name: cpuCfsQuotaPeriod

props.description: The CPU Manager policy to use. The default is 'none'. See [Kubernetes CPU management policies](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cpu-management-policies/#cpu-management-policies) for more information. Allowed values are 'none' and 'static'.
props.name: cpuManagerPolicy

props.description: If set to true it will make the Kubelet fail to start if swap is enabled on the node.
props.name: failSwapOn

props.description: The percent of disk usage after which image garbage collection is always run. To disable image garbage collection, set to 100. The default is 85%
props.name: imageGcHighThreshold

props.description: The percent of disk usage before which image garbage collection is never run. This cannot be set higher than imageGcHighThreshold. The default is 80%
props.name: imageGcLowThreshold

props.description: The maximum number of processes per pod.
props.name: podMaxPids

props.description: Specifies the default seccomp profile applied to all workloads. If not specified, 'Unconfined' will be used by default.
props.name: seccompDefault

props.description: The Topology Manager policy to use. For more information see [Kubernetes Topology Manager](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/topology-manager). The default is 'none'. Allowed values are 'none', 'best-effort', 'restricted', and 'single-numa-node'.
props.name: topologyManagerPolicy

props.description: Determines the placement of emptyDir volumes, container runtime data root, and Kubelet ephemeral storage.
props.name: kubeletDiskType

props.description: The maximum number of pods that can run on a node.
props.name: maxPods

props.description: Taints added on the node during creation that will not be reconciled by AKS. These taints will not be reconciled by AKS and can be removed with a kubectl call. These taints allow for required configuration to run before the node is ready to accept workloads, for example 'key1=value1:NoSchedule' that then can be removed with `kubectl taint nodes node1 key1=value1:NoSchedule-`
props.name: nodeInitializationTaints

props.description: The node labels on the machine.
props.name: nodeLabels

props.description: The node name in the Kubernetes cluster.
props.name: nodeName

props.description: The taints added to new node during machine create. For example, key=value:NoSchedule.
props.name: nodeTaints

props.description: The version of Kubernetes specified by the user. Both patch version <major.minor.patch> and <major.minor> are supported. When <major.minor> is specified, the latest supported patch version is chosen automatically.
props.name: orchestratorVersion

props.description: Determines the type of workload a node can run.
props.name: workloadRuntime

props.description: Machine only allows 'System' and 'User' mode.
props.name: mode

props.description: The network properties of the machine
props.name: network

props.description: Whether the machine is allocated its own public IP. Some scenarios may require the machine to receive their own dedicated public IP addresses. A common scenario is for gaming workloads, where a console needs to make a direct connection to a cloud virtual machine to minimize hops. The default is false.
props.name: enableNodePublicIP

props.description: IPv4, IPv6 addresses of the machine
To determine if address belongs IPv4 or IPv6 family
props.name: family

props.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the machine
props.name: ip
ipAddresses

props.description: The public IP prefix ID which VM node should use IPs from. This is of the form: /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Network/publicIPPrefixes/{publicIPPrefixName}
props.name: nodePublicIPPrefixID

props.description: IPTags of instance-level public IPs.
The IP tag type. Example: RoutingPreference.
props.name: ipTagType

props.description: The value of the IP tag associated with the public IP. Example: Internet.
props.name: tag
nodePublicIPTags

props.description: The ID of the subnet which pods will join when launched. If omitted, pod IPs are statically assigned on the node subnet (see vnetSubnetID for more details). This is of the form: /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/{virtualNetworkName}/subnets/{subnetName}
props.name: podSubnetID

props.description: The ID of the subnet which node and optionally pods will join on startup. If this is not specified, a VNET and subnet will be generated and used. If no podSubnetID is specified, this applies to nodes and pods, otherwise it applies to just nodes. This is of the form: /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/{virtualNetworkName}/subnets/{subnetName}
props.name: vnetSubnetID

props.description: The version of node image.

props.description: Whether the kernel should make aggressive use of memory compaction to make more hugepages available. Valid values are 'always', 'defer', 'defer+madvise', 'madvise' and 'never'. The default is 'madvise'. For more information see [Transparent Hugepages](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/admin-guide/mm/transhuge.html#admin-guide-transhuge).
props.name: transparentHugePageDefrag

props.description: Whether transparent hugepages are enabled. Valid values are 'always', 'madvise', and 'never'. The default is 'always'. For more information see [Transparent Hugepages](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/admin-guide/mm/transhuge.html#admin-guide-transhuge).
props.name: transparentHugePageEnabled

props.description: Message of the day for Linux nodes, base64-encoded. A base64-encoded string which will be written to /etc/motd after decoding. This allows customization of the message of the day for Linux nodes. It must not be specified for Windows nodes. It must be a static string (i.e., will be printed raw and not be executed as a script).
props.name: messageOfTheDay

props.description: OS Disk Size in GB to be used to specify the disk size for every machine in the master/agent pool. If you specify 0, it will apply the default osDisk size according to the vmSize specified.
props.name: osDiskSizeGB

props.description: The OS disk type to be used for machines in the agent pool. The default is 'Ephemeral' if the VM supports it and has a cache disk larger than the requested OSDiskSizeGB. Otherwise, defaults to 'Managed'. May not be changed after creation. For more information see [Ephemeral OS](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/aks/cluster-configuration#ephemeral-os).
props.name: osDiskType

props.description: Specifies the OS SKU used by the agent pool. If not specified, the default is Ubuntu if OSType=Linux or Windows2019 if OSType=Windows. And the default Windows OSSKU will be changed to Windows2022 after Windows2019 is deprecated.
props.name: osSKU

props.description: The operating system type. The default is Linux.
props.name: osType

props.description: The Windows machine's specific profile.
props.name: windowsProfile

props.description: Whether to disable OutboundNAT in windows nodes. The default value is false. Outbound NAT can only be disabled if the cluster outboundType is NAT Gateway and the Windows agent pool does not have node public IP enabled.
props.name: disableOutboundNat

props.description: The priority for the machine. If not specified, the default is 'Regular'.
props.name: priority

props.description: The current deployment or provisioning state.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: Arm resource id of the machine. It can be used to GET underlying VM Instance
props.name: resourceId

props.description: The security settings of the machine.
props.name: security

props.description: Secure Boot is a feature of Trusted Launch which ensures that only signed operating systems and drivers can boot. For more details, see aka.ms/aks/trustedlaunch.  If not specified, the default is false.
props.name: enableSecureBoot

props.description: vTPM is a Trusted Launch feature for configuring a dedicated secure vault for keys and measurements held locally on the node. For more details, see aka.ms/aks/trustedlaunch. If not specified, the default is false.
props.name: enableVTPM

props.description: SSH access method of an agent pool.
props.name: sshAccess
